hero.title:
Keymap Configure Once,
Use Everywhere.
hero.subtitle: Stop remapping shortcuts across editors. OneKeymap syncs your keybindings across VS Code, IntelliJ IDEA, Zed, and more.

features.sectionTitle: Everything you need to unify your workflow
features.sectionSubtitle: OneKeymap is packed with features to make your life easier.

editor.title: Unified Keymap Editor
editor.description: Manage all your keybindings in one intuitive interface. Record, edit, and organize shortcuts with zero friction.

sync.title: Safe Sync with Diff Preview
sync.description: Preview every change before you write to disk. Unified diffs highlight adds, edits, and removals so nothing slips through.

import.title: Seamless Import
import.description: Bring existing shortcuts from VS Code, IntelliJ IDEA, Zed, and more into OneKeymap with a single click.

pricing.title: Pick the OneKeymap plan that suits you
pricing.subtitle: OneKeymap is a native macOS app that keeps your shortcuts in sync.

monthly.name: Monthly
monthly.description: Flexible access to OneKeymap with a subscription you can cancel anytime.
monthly.feature1: Sync shortcuts across every supported editor

annually.name: Annually
annually.description: Best balance of value and flexibility, with priority access to new features.
annually.feature1: Sync shortcuts across every supported editor
annually.feature2: 1 year of updates and new features

lifetime.name: Lifetime
lifetime.description: Own OneKeymap forever with a single payment and lock in future updates.
lifetime.feature1: Sync shortcuts across every supported editor
